[EN] A medic's duty never ends.
[ES] El deber de un médico nunca termina.

[EN] Don't you leave now! You never backed away from anything in your life. Now fight!
[ES] ¡No te vayas ahora! Jamás te has acobardado ante nada en tu vida. ¡Ahora lucha!

[EN] Triage is a bitter business, friend.
[ES] La clasificación de heridos es un asunto amargo, amigo.

[EN] How does a storm appear out of nowhere?
[ES] ¿Cómo aparece una tormenta de la nada?
